reviews_5s:
I got this to put sand in a punching bag. Worked good, if I were to go back, I would’ve got one with a little bit wider of a mouth. But this did what I needed to do.Good funnel.

The user W. Murray said in his review that it's 31.5mm across the spout. He and I must be measuring different things, because the bottom of the neck is about 23mm wide (see photo).I purchased this funnel to use with flushing and filling my 2008 jeep jk radiator cooling system. The spout fits nicely where the radiator fill opening is, and the funnel is wide enough to pour into from a 5 gallon bucket or a gallon container. Just what I needed!Great quality simple basic funnel. One nice touch is little grooves/teeth on the input spout so it kind of locks into the opening of whatever you’re pouring into. I’ve never seen that before. Cheap price too.I dehydrate food when I stumble across a 'can't pass this sale up' product and when I'm ready to get them in the mason jars and seal them, I want to get the chore done fast as I'm working with oxygen absorbers and a vacuum sealer. This has a wide enough funnel on it to easily allow dehydrated foods through it and I can pick up two handfuls of the dehydrated foods and dump them into the bowl portion of this with ease and without making a mess. It does not sit evenly on the jar opening but that is a plus for this use as the angle by which it rests on the jar opening helps the dehydrated foods slide through the funnel portion easier and without coaxing from me. The job of getting the dehydrated foods into their new homes faster, cleaner and more efficiently is now enjoyable. I used to dread that part because I would make such a mess. Even a regular wide-mouth canning funnel doesn't work as well as this because the funnel portion can get clogged and then I need to stop what I'm doing to jiggle the regular canning funnel or tease the clogged food through the funnel portion with a knife.

This has saved me so much time and effort in the kitchen that I'm in love with a funnel intended for putting oil in your vehicle. As such, I feared the men in the family would swipe it for its intended purpose - so I came back and got enough for all of them plus a few extras. And mine? Well, I'll keep mine hidden in the kitchen so they can't find it when they're too lazy to find their own!

I doubt this is food grade plastic and I can't see anywhere on the label stuck to the side of it that it is BPA free so I would never use it as a regular funnel in the kitchen for foods that are cooked, moist, hot or liquid but I figure the rapid pace at which dehydrated items pass through this thing and the fact that those foods are crispy critters as well, they aren't in this long enough to become contaminated.I like the widemouth feature and very easy to apply oil in my vehicleNO spills with this.Good flow,holds its own.It works! A helpful addition to the tool collection.Nice and wide, easy to use.
I would recommend to others
reviews_1s:
Not sure what I can use this for. It’s kinda useless. It’s my fault for not checking the dimensions I guess.I needed a large funnel…. This picture looked large and description made me believe it was large …… nope it is just a regular size funnelBefore buying this I checked the reviews to see if anybody tried this on a Ford. One review said it didn't fit but another said it did. Well I tried it and it did not fit on a Ford Ranger, I think a Mustang and Explorer have the same oil cap so no go for a Ford. Hopkins should list that... I returned mine.The nozzle on this would not fit into the crankcase opening.. nor would it fit in a milk jug opening.. or a 2-liter bottle opening.. or even the lid of a regular quart of oil.

I'll have to find another use for this. I was not able to use it for its intended purpose.Locking mechanism was not effective, this was slightly too big for a 2003 Hyundai Tiburon 2.0L, twisting it into the oil fill it seemed to lock in but spilled oil everywhere.Too small.I can't pour a gallon like the advertisement.
Make it bigger and I'll buy another.This one is uselessThe spout is too big for the 2015 Honda CRV and won't fit. Fine, maybe the vehicle has an extra small hole.
